notablePrerequisites:
Burning Anger and Ophidian Eye attached to Tolarian Kraken.
Tolarian Kraken does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Tolarian Kraken by tapping it, dealing damage equal to its power to any opponent.
Ophidian Eye triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Tolarian Kraken triggers, holding priority, activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Resolve the Tolarian Kraken trigger, causing you to pay {1} to untap it.
Repeat.
